title: The committed placement policy resolves a job by capability, then root, then its nearest group, then the default of the workstation
goal: policy/kbjobs/placement.rego (package kbjobs.placement) returns the decision object kbjob.py place reads, with `default` values executor workstation and identity none; it takes, first match wins, a capability rule (data.kbjobs.capabilities), the subject's root (data.kbjobs.roots), the operator's nearest group with a server override (data.kbjobs.overrides) before its committed group file (policy/kbjobs/groups/<group path>/data.json), then the default, and names the level in decided_by; policy/kbjobs/placement_test.rego covers each level, the nearest group winning over an ancestor, an override over a committed group file and the default; opa test passes

run:
import subprocess,shutil
o=shutil.which("opa"); assert o, "opa is not on PATH"
r=subprocess.run([o,"test","policy/kbjobs","-v"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120); print(r.stdout[-3000:])
assert r.returncode==0 and "placement_test" in r.stdout, r.stderr

import subprocess,shutil,json,tempfile,os
o=shutil.which("opa"); assert o, "opa is not on PATH"
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); f=lambda n,v: (open(os.path.join(d,n),"w").write(json.dumps(v)), os.path.join(d,n))[1]
data=f("data.json",{"kbjobs":{"overrides":{"corp":{"check":{"executor":"server"}},"corp/ops":{"check":{"executor":"ci","identity":"none"}}}}})
ev=lambda inp: json.loads(subprocess.run([o,"eval","-f","json","-d","policy/kbjobs","-d",data,"-i",f("i.json",inp),"data.kbjobs.placement"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60).stdout)["result"][0]["expressions"][0]["value"]
a=ev({"op":"check","subject":"backlog-check","groups":["corp","corp/ops"],"operator":"corp/ops/jan.kowalski","roots":[],"root_groups":[],"host":"PL-LT-00123","capabilities":{"paid":False,"push":False}})
b=ev({"op":"land","subject":"ST-aaaaaaaa","groups":["corp","corp/dev"],"operator":"corp/dev/anna.nowak","roots":[],"root_groups":[],"host":"PL-LT-00123","capabilities":{"paid":False,"push":True}})
assert a["executor"]=="ci" and a["decided_by"].endswith("corp/ops"), a
assert b["executor"]=="workstation" and b["identity"]=="none", b

notes: Research 2026-11-08: OPA bundle manifest roots, resource default bundles/<name>, Etag/304, bearer token_path, ${NAME} substitution only under opa run and only for defined variables, persistence_directory default $PWD/.opa, and test discovery by the test_ prefix are in kb public/agents/policy-as-code.md (QK-operations-placement-stories-need-opa-bundles).
